comments.body: Done in 19f9afd7: AskingEntry carries a blocked pane's subtitle (roster::pane_subtitle), and the strip reads it; waiting/unreachable wording still wins as on a row.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 8076015d another window's agents are named in the Needs you strip, but a blocked card's detail line (the pane's subtitle, saying what it is blocked on) still comes from this window's roster, so a blocked agent in another window shows its name and state with no detail line. The core could carry the subtitle in AskingEntry beside the callsign and label.
title: A blocked agent in another window has no subtitle in the Needs you strip
